title: 67-year-old woman with palpitations and dizziness
presenting_complaint: Sudden onset palpitations and lightheadedness for 2 hours, feels her heart 'racing irregularly'.

history_items.question: Ask about onset and character
history_items.finding: Sudden onset, irregular racing sensation, no clear trigger.

history_items.question: Ask about prior similar episodes
history_items.finding: Two similar shorter episodes in the past year that self-resolved.
history_items.evidence_basis: Paroxysmal pattern history raises suspicion for atrial fibrillation.

history_items.question: Ask about thyroid symptoms
history_items.finding: No heat intolerance, tremor, or weight loss.
history_items.evidence_basis: Screens for hyperthyroidism as a reversible AF trigger.

history_items.question: Ask about alcohol intake
history_items.finding: Had a wedding celebration with heavy alcohol intake yesterday.
history_items.evidence_basis: 'Holiday heart syndrome' — alcohol is a recognized AF trigger.

examination_items.evidence_basis: Irregularly irregular pulse is the classic bedside sign of atrial fibrillation.

examination_items.finding: No murmurs, no signs of heart failure.

investigations.name: 12-lead ECG
investigations.result_summary: Atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response, rate 148, no P waves, irregularly irregular R-R intervals.
investigations.result_detail: Classic AF pattern, no acute ischemic changes.
investigations.evidence_basis: ECG is diagnostic for atrial fibrillation.

investigations.name: TSH
investigations.evidence_basis: Standard reversible-cause screen in new AF.

investigations.name: Electrolytes (including magnesium)
investigations.result_detail: Mild hypomagnesemia, consistent with recent heavy alcohol intake.

differentials.name: Atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response

clinical_decisions.label: Rate control (beta blocker), anticoagulation risk assessment, correct magnesium
clinical_decisions.rationale: Standard first-line approach for new AF with RVR in a hemodynamically stable patient.

clinical_decisions.label: Proceed straight to electrical cardioversion without checking duration/anticoagulation status
clinical_decisions.rationale: Unsafe: cardioverting AF of uncertain duration without addressing stroke-risk/anticoagulation first risks embolic stroke.

outcome_branches.title: Appropriate initial management
outcome_branches.narrative: Rate control is achieved with a beta blocker, magnesium is corrected, and a formal anticoagulation and rhythm-control plan is arranged with cardiology follow-up.
outcome_branches.educational_explanation: Rate control plus a structured stroke-risk assessment is the correct first step for new, hemodynamically stable AF with RVR.

outcome_branches.title: Unsafe shortcut
outcome_branches.narrative: Cardioversion is attempted without addressing anticoagulation; fortunately no embolic event occurs this time, but the team is flagged for a safety review.
outcome_branches.educational_explanation: Skipping the duration/anticoagulation assessment before cardioversion is a recognized, dangerous shortcut — even when it doesn't cause harm on a given occasion, it's not a safe process.

counterfactual_branches.alternative_action_label: What if you had treated based on pulse palpation alone, without an ECG?
counterfactual_branches.alternative_evidence: An irregularly irregular pulse is suggestive but not fully diagnostic — the ECG confirms AF and rules out other irregular rhythms.
counterfactual_branches.probability_effect: Meaningful loss of diagnostic certainty; could not confidently exclude another irregular tachycardia.
counterfactual_branches.potential_outcome: Risk of treating the wrong rhythm.
counterfactual_branches.reasoning_lesson: A bedside sign should prompt, not replace, the confirmatory ECG in tachyarrhythmias.

reasoning_error_catalog.label: Poor investigation selection
reasoning_error_catalog.educational_note: ECG is required to confirm AF before committing to a rhythm-control strategy.

reasoning_error_catalog.label: Ignoring red flags
reasoning_error_catalog.educational_note: Skipping stroke-risk/anticoagulation assessment before cardioversion ignores a critical safety step.

ml_feature_hint.note: See docs/DATASETS.md for the dataset's empirical (non-standard) cp/exang encoding used here.

references: Standard MBBS-level new atrial fibrillation with RVR teaching pathway (rate control, stroke risk assessment before cardioversion).
